notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Commanders!
[/h2]
I'm Roid, the director of "Corrupted: Dawn of Havoc," a real-time deck-building game.

Currently, after several updates, Corrupted is now available on Steam Early Access.

In fact, the first Early Access began back in September 2023 through Stove. Despite being released with various shortcomings at the time, many of you played it and provided valuable feedback, which helped us improve Corrupted.

Our team is working hard to release the complete version of Corrupted, including all the content we envision, by 2024, but there's still much to be done.

In today's developer diary, let's explore how the Early Access release has progressed and what content and updates we can expect in the future.

[h2]STEAM Early Access Release
[/h2]
Firstly, heartfelt thanks to all the Commanders who have been with us since last year. As gamers before developers, we understand that trusting and purchasing an Early Access version of a game is a big ask. Therefore, we're diligently preparing for 2024 to repay your trust in Corrupted.

[h2]Path towards Official Release
[/h2]
The official release version of Corrupted aims to challenge you to experiment with various strategies through recruiting new members and customization, ultimately clearing the highest difficulty, Very Hard. Following that, we'll continue updating with various rules applied in the Daily Challenge mode, where you can renew your daily clear score ranking.

[h2]Scheduled Updates
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [strike]Research Tree Renewal (Completed)[/strike]
[*] Hard Mode Levels 1-10
[*] Multiple Endings
[*] New Member Customization: Specialization
[*] New Mode: Daily Challenge
[*] 4 New Members
[*] 3 New Unique Equipment
[*] New Plugins
[/list]


We hope you enjoy your experience with Corrupted. We'll continue to bring you various updates in the future. Thank you!

notes.title: Hello Commanders
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders,
It has been a year since we unveiled our first demo. We are thrilled to be on the verge of launching our early access!

We are excited to welcome both new and returning players to the upcoming early access version, and we plan to continue adding exciting new content and features throughout the early access period based on the community's feedback. Please add our game to your wishlist on our Steam store page.

Your feedback is crucial!

From the initial alpha to the demo and beta testing, your feedback has played a pivotal role in defining our deck-building game with real-time card play. Getting to know the community while developing the game has been an amazing journey, and we cannot thank you enough for your support. There are many exciting new features waiting for you in early access, and we are eager to hear your thoughts.

Launching the game in early access is the perfect opportunity to welcome you to the world of Corrupted: Dawn of Havoc, where we can add and refine features based on community feedback. You've been with us every step of the journey, but from this moment on, you will experience real-time bug fixes and regular game updates.

You can share feedback and suggestions on the Corrupted: Dawn of Havoc Discord channel.
(https://discord.gg/Ww6JrMuTNn)

[h3][b]Exciting New Features[/b][/h3]
Thanks to you, there are several core features already included in the early access version of the game and more to be updated later!

[b][Already Added][/b]
1. Damage meters (combat statistics)
2. Wave-based combat system
3. Card special enhancements (Exsim system)

[b][Planned Additions][/b]
1. Order Card (like LoL's Summoner Spell)
2. Co-op
3. Endless mode
As requested since we opened Discord, we will focus on updating planned features and adding new characters.

We've also created many new additions ourselves, and we look forward to watching you discover all of them. We believe the best way to experience the new features is by playing the game, so we don't want to reveal too much, but we will provide thorough patch notes for everything from minor changes to new additions.

notes.notes:
Hello Commanders!
Starting today until December 31, the [u]first beta version[/u] of Corrupted is now available. Check out the various updates prepared in this new version right away!

[h2]What is the Beta Test Version?
[/h2]The beta test allows you to experience all the features of the main game developed so far for a set period. Unlike the previous demo version, you can play up to Chapter 3 and use growth content like research and traits without limitations.

[h2]Chapter 3: Laxen Space Station
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/1ffe9e0400981b7c2e256e0676b006c2eeb95cc6.jpg[/img]
Chapter 3, the final story of Corrupted, has been added.
The Corrupted, now stronger and with new abilities due to mysterious body modifications, appear in front of the Paladin squad members who have arrived at the station to leave the planet Laxen. The commander's conflict deepens as the duty to complete the mission with the clue to the planet's secret at hand clashes with the responsibility for the safe return of their subordinates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/41185c8cc44e445cbfda30e5ad41d5ff38070295.png[/img]

[h2]Adjustment of Existing Chapter Volumes
[/h2]With the addition of Chapter 3, we have shortened the length of Chapters 1 and 2 from 16 days to 12 days, and Chapter 3 to 10 days, to prevent the game from becoming excessively long. This will allow you to progress through various stages at a faster pace, and complete up to Chapter 3 within the time it used to take to complete Chapter 2.

[h2]New Cards
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/81ea0a930b23204f1c0887941cc3c347de36b37e.png[/img]
We are introducing cards that were in the development plan but had been postponed due to other issues. Especially Boom, which is a core mechanic card that hadn’t been developed yet. Lucky for us!

[h2]Balance Adjustments
[/h2]
[h3]Stage 0 Reward Addition
[/h3]After encountering the Chapter 1 boss, a new reward choice will be created at the next session's Stage 0. These rewards are designed with a high-risk, high-return concept, so careful selection is required.
[h3]Equipment Balance Change
[/h3]Carbon Armor (Nerf): At the start of combat, gain HP 30, Attack and Defense +5 per second (up to 20 stacks) → Gain HP 20, Attack +2, Defense +1 per second (up to 30 stacks)
[h3]Craftsman Rat (Nerf)

[*] Enhance all basic cards → Randomly enhance 1-2 basic cards per squad member

[/list]
[h3]Elite & Boss Status Immunity Rule Changes
[/h3]We wanted the elite and boss battles to have as few variables as possible, so we made them immune to all status effects during breaks. However, we realized this caused too many cards to lose their effectiveness and limited deck building.
[list]
[*] When elite has armor: all status effects applicable, duration of all effects reduced by 25%
[*] When boss has armor: all status effects applicable, duration of all effects reduced by 50%
[/list]

[h2]Visual Element Changes
[/h2]

[list]

[*] Throwrer, Caveguard, Mudstar: Enhanced visibility of these enemies' skill effects.
[*] Adjusted card play UI layout to match the increased maximum hand size.

notes.title: 0.7 demo Update released!
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders!
We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest patch!

In this update, not only have we introduced new content and visual updates, but we've also implemented significant system changes and balance improvements to enhance the gameplay experience.

There's a lot to get excited about, so without further ado, here's what's new:

[h2]1. Day Loading Background and UI Changes
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/f676e6e27aa5b40744f2a157dc5ea30b873ee70f.gif[/img]
We've refreshed the day transition animations and user interface for a smoother experience.


[h2]2. Card Draw System Overhaul
[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Card Effects: Draw, Choose to Discard
[*] Draw: Immediately pull the top card from the deck into the back of your hand, bypassing cooldowns. Excess cards drawn over the hand limit will be discarded immediately.
[*] Choose to Discard: Select and discard a specified number of cards from your hand.
[*] Added Draw Cooldown: We felt that the previous system of drawing up to the hand limit in one go was diminishing the fun of card playing. We've revamped this to make deck management and draw control a strategic resource.
[*] Draw 1 card every 3 seconds after combat starts.
[*] Expanded Draw Limit: Maximum hand size increased from 5 to 7.
[*] New Card Shortcuts: Keys 1-5 + QWERT (with options for re-binding these shortcuts coming soon).
[*] Maximum Hand Limit: Drawing will pause once the maximum hand limit is reached.
[*] Reduced Reload Time: Reload time decreased from 4 to 3 seconds.
[/list]

[h2]3. Block System Changes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blocks now last for 5 seconds from the time of application, then fade to 0% over 2 seconds. Unlike healing, which is limited by maximum health, blocks could stack indefinitely. We believe this change will encourage more strategic timing in their use for defense.
[/list]

[h2]4. New Equipment and System Changes
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/7d8607a951c1adac545900002cbc36d07bcb79a5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Introducing the 1.5 Tier 'Natz' Series Equipment: We've adjusted the item progression curve to address the excess of combination items in Chapter 2. Some of the combination equipment rewards have been replaced with this new tier to maintain the fun of item-based progression without clutter.
[*] Removal of Equipment Sales in Shop: Equipment items will no longer be restocked in the shop.
[*] Added Equipment Disassembly: Surplus equipment can now be disassembled in the shop for consumables and credits.
[/list]


[h2]Balance[/h2]

[h3]Cards:
[/h3]

Tactician, Tactician*:
Cost changed from 2 to 3, block value increased.
Now provides a constant aura of defense, giving 8%/13%* to allies within 2 tiles.
Removed the unique tag.

Bandage Pack:
Cost reduced from 2 to 1.
Number of bandages created reduced from 3 to 2.
Added a decay effect.

Bandage Pack*:
Number of bandages created reduced from 3 to 2.

Metabolism, Metabolism*:
Upon card decay, HP recovery changed from 6% to 3%/5%*.
Added the unique tag.

Exhaustion:
Reduced the energy acceleration penalty while the card is in hand from -50% to -15%.
Draw Effects Added.

Reallign:
Removed HP recovery effect, now draws 1 card.
Added decay effect.

Reallign*:
Removed HP recovery effect, now draws 1 card.

Finisher:
Changed additional damage from negative effects to draw 1 card if the target is defeated with this card.

Axe Throw:
Changed Rampage's attack power boost during skill block to draw 1 card.

Rage:
Now decays all non-attack cards in hand and draws a number of cards minus one of the decayed cards.

Diversion:

notes.title: 0.5 Update - Roguelite, more
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders!

The permanent growth factor that many commanders have requested has finally been updated. Along with various balance changes, we have begun to take steps towards a great game, so please read the update notes with high expectations!

[h1]Permanent Growth Factors[/h1]

[h2]1. Research[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/a39e5db8e4f65b48dda1f9ed6fa63f8b628d4742.gif[/img]
Strengthen your team using Zeronium in the ‘Research’ tab in the menu! You can earn Zeronium in proportion to your score after the game ends. Various other researches are planned to be updated!

[h2]2. Traits[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/732e06a3e9f763c860c45de2f3ccdd2f96faf0e2.gif[/img]
Traits are special abilities that can be equipped three at a time for each member. Customize your members according to your strategy through various trait combinations! Traits can be obtained by achieving achievements. About 10 types of traits are planned to be updated for each character.

[h2]3. Achievements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/72023b98b0c034a66ed732687a40751a461adcad.gif[/img]
The achievement system has been added. Achievements consist of rewards that greatly assist in permanent growth, such as Zeronium for research, traits, lieutenants, etc. Play more enjoyably by challenging various plays and acquiring these rewards!

[h2]4. Lieutenants[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/97ea0efa8494b65cb9657ff4a1e3c44d6df0b098.gif[/img]
Lieutenants have been introduced to Corrupted, who will help you progress in the game. Lieutenants provide rewards at the starting stage and have unique abilities. They can be obtained through achievements and events.

[h1]Combat System Improvements[/h1]

[h2]1. Armor / Break System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/d3c894544edfa1d75e4f74465e2c2d22ad9816ff.gif[/img]
Previously, only skills with the ‘stun’ effect could block skills. There was fun in stunning at the right timing, but the value of the stun was too high, making it difficult to try various concepts. Therefore, we created a ‘defense break’ system, where the enemy is stunned and takes increased damage when dealt a certain amount of damage. Now you can flexibly choose whether to focus damage to break defense or to use a stun skill to block the skill.

[h2]2. Morale Effect Change and Trauma System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/2b4b518dfb82e4c4afc6f418cca6b7a9c34f45aa.gif[/img]
The original morale was an element we wanted to create a need to manage the team through continuous damage accumulation. However, contrary to our intentions, it brought too much snowball in a single battle.

[b][Changes][/b]

Addition of sectional morale levels

Positive (100~75%): Random ally positive effect acquisition
Disturbed (74~50%): Random ally 1st level trauma acquisition
Anxious (29~25%): Random ally 2nd level trauma acquisition
Corruption (24%~0%): Random ally 3rd level trauma acquisition
Morale application time change
Morale effects apply at the start of the next battle. Even if morale drops, there is now room to respond, such as using recovery items or modifying the deployment.

[h1]Camp Card Enhancement & Removal UX Improvement[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/c89d03881ac69ef3ecd7d8bacacd5ab37c0592b1.gif[/img]
The much-requested 'card enhancement preview' has been added. Now, you can carefully choose to enhance cards after viewing the enhancement effects!

[h1]Shop New Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/9c89ff3aeb50d9c17c3f5db5d0c2c618aa7b25ac.gif[/img]
Finally, the Cosmic Shop and Midas combination have arrived in Corrupted! In the ‘Shop Protocol’ stage, you can use the ‘credits’ earned during the game to buy cards, plugins, equipment, and various other items.

[h1]New Consumables and Exism[/h1]
[h3]Exism[/h3]
The basic exorcism granted to the card will now be removed, leaving only the exism slot. Instead, you can use the ‘exism’ item acquired during the game for free custom effects that fit the situation.

[h3]Morale Recovery Agent[/h3]
Has your morale dropped and the camp is not appearing? You can now use ‘Morale Recovery Agent’ to instantly recover morale.

[h3]Resurrection Item[/h3]
If you are worried about the risk of a member dying during stage progression, try using an Automatic Defibrillator (modified), Revival Beacon. The automatic defibrillator has been changed from a type used before battle to a type that is used automatically when a member dies.
※ Various other consumables have been added, so check them out in the demo!

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
1. Entering the next stage no longer fully recovers all health.
    The damage taken in the previous stage accumulates, and only minimal health recovery is provided.

2. The effect of skill-blocking used against an enemy trying to use a skill has been weakened.
    - SP 50% return => SP 80% return

3. The recovery effects used by enemies have been reduced.

4. The damage of SP skills has been universally decreased.
    - Show off the commander's abilities through deck construction.

6. You can no longer freely unequip the equipped gear.
    - Touch and Move! Consider the timing of equipping your gear more carefully.
    - However, you can unequip it using a new consumable item called Equipment Removal Kit.

Every single one of your comments, suggestions, and feedback is all being considered thoroughly as we continue our development for the full release.

notes.title: 0.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm here to give you an update!

We focused on continuously adding content and improving gameability.

I'll introduce what parts have changed!






[i][h2]Card Renewal[/h2][/i]
As our game is a card-based combat system, we decided that card playing should have enough meaning.

So I changed all the existing cards and focused on building a new card.


[b]<Default card for each character type>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/971c39c6084164615f4d89992ce0a354e90a067b.png[/img]
In "Corrupted," there are four character type: Charge, Shooter, Firepower, and Support.

Each type has a different combat role, and it's made up of distinctive cards.

However, rather than providing all the character cards from the beginning of the game, I decided that getting character cards one by one would be a great fun in growing characters.

So if you choose the characters you want and start the game, you will be given a basic card package for each type at first.

Starting with these card packages, the decks will be filled one by one with the card rewards you get as you proceed with the stage, and it will appear as an element to grow and strengthen your members.


[b]<Exism>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/4832b16b00db20b08311059ab416fae4579ee421.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/34841104e9b594f1ea51406c3362d9c53b23c53b.png[/img]
An element called 'exism' appears that affects card hand play.

This 'exism' has a big impact on the card effect itself, but most of it consists of effects that can play a chain advantage in card play using energy.

When a battle occurs, the card is often used to control the victory, so it is an intended system that uses card 'exism' to efficiently fight.




[i][h2]Change the design of the H.P bar and add indicators[/h2][/i]

[b]<Change the design of the H.P bar>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/b278d27bfdf14468b9bb5076d17f24f185fb2a46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/03d5d9bcf4b388ad10539ea12ed195bdbdaa77b4.png[/img]
The design of the existing flat H.P bar has been changed beautifully!

The focus on increased visibility and design makes it easier to check your physical strength even during chaotic battles.


[b]<Add indicators>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/5d2af2d5dfa1e9d9c7228e404fa489cb0d3cd9c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/099cead8ab28d9e190bdb78311bf4b8c9338e74e.png[/img]
One of the most frequently talked about stories was damage marking and status anomalies during combat, and skill visibility.

We now know what skills we use and how much damage this skill can do to our enemies. [strike](I don't know if the skill was used..)[/strike]

In addition, the skill effect makes it easier to see at a glance whether the condition anomaly can be applied to the enemy.

notes.notes:
Hello, I'm here again to bring you some new news!

Getting feedback from testing and your valuable reviews, we've stepped up efforts to improve the overall quality of our game!

Let's take a look at what has been added and changed!



[i][h2]Add Skill Cancellation System[/h2][/i]
I improved the part where the card was not used due to 'xx is busy'.

Even if your character is using a skill, you can cancel it using a card that takes different actions.

It can be used for various purposes depending on the skill level, such as reducing the delay by linking cards and skills.

However, if you cancel the skill before it takes effect, the effects that have not taken effect will disappear.




[i][h2]Change deck editing system[/h2][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/722f3a425f59757f6bedb50a383b8a75bdef023e.png[/img]
Until now, it has been free to pack deck piles by adding and removing cards that users want to suit their taste on the deck editing screen.

However, our developers judged that it would be more strategic fun to get the best choices and the best efficiency in a limited situation than to give them the freedom to edit the deck.

[b]<Edit Deck -> deck management>[/b]
Corrected it to 'Dek Management' instead of 'Edit Deck'.

It's because the user can't edit it at will now. [strike](Factors that increase the difficulty level?)[/strike]

Instead, you'll be given the opportunity to overhaul your deck on the added 'rest' stage, as you'll see in more detail below! (ex card removed)

[i][h2]New Stage - Rest Area[/h2][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/9f5327c1ffd3315969161af977279ab770427d55.png[/img]
A stage that appears in the stage selection stage, such as General Battle, Unknown.

Whenever you enter the resting place, your mascot character, the rat, will welcome you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/a50c06b75adb376428b78666555ab50295f18638.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/c81a089bcba696ebe175e386df6f029360a22b61.png[/img]
The functions available here include [b]'Enhancing morale'[/b] and [b]'Crushing machine'[/b].
(You can use only one of the two functions per visit.)

You can restore the morale gauge with the morale-boosting function, and you can select and remove cards from the cards you currently have with the shredder function.

[b]<What does morale have to do with rhythm games?>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/fe99bddbfd57ba39e83aaf47b92604cdce16e598.gif[/img]
When we introduced the system called fraud, there was a lot of talk about the lack of content to raise fraud. So what I came up with was, "Let's put in a morale boost function through the rest area stage!"

This simple mini-game result changes the amount of morale recovery.
[strike](I'm not good at rhythm games.. → Then take good care of Morale~)[/strike]

[b]<Remove the card through a shredder>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/da4beea5776cb49dc214fd3287459b26479e8f7b.png[/img]
Deck editing has become impossible as users want, but card removal has become possible through the shredder function in the resting place!
With this function, you can set up your own deck and use it strategically.

[i][h2]Reinforced Monster System[/h2][/i]
Monsters with certain status anomalies appear intermittently!

Reinforcement monsters are dangerous enemies that can have powerful effects on themselves or fatal effects on enemy forces. (It's also the number one elimination target.)

The effects of these reinforcement monsters are mostly indelible capabilities, and they will greet you with a tricky enemy that makes it difficult for users to fight! [strike](I never wanted to..)[/strike]

Reinforcement monsters look just like other monsters, but they are easily recognizable by their visible special effects.



[i][h2]Adding a Sudden Death System[/h2][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/4ca0a5230160af832e8f3c36963a9e21982d21d4.png[/img]
If only one of our allies who lacked the ability to attack and one of our self-recoverable enemies were left alone in battle, the game would not end and would last almost forever.

The system added to solve these problems is [b]'Sudden Death'[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/ca75c3ab3a5b4cbaf3e216492df984365cf78ce5.gif[/img]
When the battle begins, the Sudden Death counter will begin in the upper right corner. (Timer time varies depending on the number of team members and the type of battle stage)

It doesn't matter if the battle ends within that time, but if the battle continues until later, the Sudden Death rule applies. (Increase of damage, Increase of attack speed, etc.)

In addition, if the battle is terminated through Sudden Death, a little disadvantage applies from our side. (Reduced morale due to battle fatigue)



[i][h2]Bug Fixs[/h2][/i]
- A bug where certain plug-in contents were not visible (text error)
- The fact that the input was not properly intermittently during the rhythm game at the resting place

- Bug where tooltips for buff & debuff tiles sometimes didn't pop up
- A bug that broke the alignment when using the hand's card as a keyboard shortcut
- A bug where the SP of a particular monster was raised even before the battle started
- At the end of the battle, the end of the battle sound was sometimes not heard

notes.title: 0.2 Update - Major Renewal!
notes.notes:
[i][h1]Major Updates[/h1]
[/i]
Hello, commanders! Greetings after 2 months since the last update.

In the meantime, we have conducted various tests with your reviews to identify and improve the problems of the existing game, and we needed time for an overall renewal as well as some improvements for various in-game elements.

We've made significant improvements to the parts that were disappointing while playing Corrupted, so please check it out!



[i][h2]Event renewal
[/h2]
[/i]As many reviewers pointed out, the previous event was a bit lacking.
[strike]In fact, it was so absurd and so unfunny! sorry![/strike]

[b]<Analyzing existing event issues>[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/0bbed76c77559c0f9fd520172e782b9ac7ed0fdb.png[/img]
(It's full of text, and even the fatigue of having to choose between risks...)

Therefore, we decided to improve this part in the direction of [u]complete renewal[/u] by spending a long time!

[h3][b]<NEW EVENTS>[/b]
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/8e9ee92f6ef461cb0bd17da84060deda045de85c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/a1a5bde3ffbd3dfe57497e37ab22ce1e4dbf738a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increase the immersion of the event content by using illustrations (quality work will continue)
[*] Improve visibility by changing the overall event flow and design
[*] Properly structured event content and various texts to generate interest
[*] Increased awareness of reward content using tooltips
[/list]
Currently, there are a total of three events that can be met, and unlike before, there are various branching results for each choice, so you can enjoy enough fun even when repeating. (We plan to provide more types of events through future updates!)

[i][h2]Stage creation method Renewal[/h2]
[/i]Existing stages were made in a straight line, so we tried to control game variables as much as possible, but this also limited the user's options. I thought it was enough to have a choice at the entrance event.

But it was a completely wrong choice. As we played with the choice removed, we realized that the rewards we expected were not visible and we only progressed through luck, resulting in a loss of interest in progress.

To solve this problem, we decided to provide a 'random stage card' that combines rewards and battle types every DAY.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/3932afc9426495163884d9225afce3a5cd85a757.png[/img]
This is a DAY transition. You can check the path you have already taken, and you can also check hints for hidden elements at the bottom. If the next destination is a fixed stage, information about that stage is also shown in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/952bcfb6c3557f723cf83899ba770d57f83554b2.png[/img]
This is the stage selection stage. Now, commanders can check the rewards and battle difficulty in advance, and can select the stage to enter according to the team's situation.


[i][h2]New Stage - Swarm Battle[/h2]
[/i]Many people commented that it was regrettable that similar battles were repeated every time they played the game over and over again.
We are planning various battle modes to solve this, and with this continuous battle update, we are able to debut a new battle mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/773ba8b533a0652d9f14f4a6e7007545678747e9.png[/img]
[b][Rules][/b]
[list]
[*] One continuous battle consists of 3 waves.
[*] After one wave battle is over, you can reposition your team when preparing for the next wave.
[*] Damage received in battle is cumulative, and HP of obstacles is also maintained.
[*] At the end of each wave, all allies recover 20% of their max HP.
[*] There is a new tile, 'Instant Recovery' tile, at each wave preparation stage, and allies above this tile are restored to 100%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/bdd4e9febf81a448e69b1dcb7abd52129350de75.png[/img]
[*] As it is a hard difficulty mode, a supply box reward is waiting for you when you clear it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/3386cbd1e1a83cb526ea3cd133b59d7cdefa6d97.png[/img]
[/list]

[i][h2]New Elite[/h2]
[/i][b][[Bloodsucker]]
[/b][list]
[*] Description: It is unclear what she was doing. Except for the fact that one arm is a cyborg, and that arm has mutated and become a formidable threat.

[*] Rating: Normal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/f991632e44bb647273cfc0016272dae623e830c4.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b][[Hugger]]

[*] Rating: Normal

[*] Rating: Normal
[*] Type: Support
[*] Basic Attack: Pincer Bite (Range: Melee)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/85f4cf88217698ecfd27a3e16e8ad39e8d85f8a3.gif[/img]
[*] Skill : Incomplete Enhancement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/d07954980c4ad4b09fa2aac168bbd15e7dab8646.gif[/img]
[/list]


[i][h1]Minor Updates[/h1]
[/i]
[i][h3]Morale System Changes[/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/e1a9b8412eea193724ea8d673cfd8ae24da77dbb.png[/img]
Later in the game, I noticed that the max morale didn't change even as the crew increased, making the difficulty even harder.
Therefore, we changed the morale value from integer type (existing) to % (changed) and changed it to always have the same risk even when adding characters.
Also, morale can now be restored through stage card 'Camp' and Survivor Backpack rewards.

[i][h3]Added battle random modifier[/h3]
[/i]New elements have also been added to regular combat. It's '[b]Reinforcement[/b]', and when the count passes, additional enemies appear from all sides. Check out the game for details!

[i][h3]New tiles[/h3]
[/i][b]<Area Fixed Tile>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/a2a92f3c6c1b9a293f7eff117530acd63c2c1f05.png[/img]

[b]<Instant Healing Tile>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647035/bdd4e9febf81a448e69b1dcb7abd52129350de75.png[/img]

[i][h3]Balance improvement[/h3]
[/i]Overall, it seems that the increase in difficulty for each level is too big.
The enemy's level has now been deleted, and the enemy's stat increases gradually according to the daily stat increase formula.

[b][Miscellaneous fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Weakened basic stats of allies and enemies
[*] (Nerf) Decrease basic HP of Assault type allies (Rampage, A.J)
[*] (Buff) Shooter type (purple, gunhead) range increase 4→6 buff
[*] (Buff) less frequently used Fuse, Relief Max SP reduction
[*] (Buff) Parasite Queen max SP reduction
[*] (Rework) When hatching a parasite egg, damage increases in proportion to the remaining shield (3.5 to 0.5 times damage)
[/list]

[h3]Convenience and UX improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added stun animation for all characters
[*] Changed the non-placeable tile grid display to be distinguished
[*] Improved damage font visibility
[*] Added optional features (play background sound, adjust mouse pointer size)
[*] Add pause using spacebar during battle
[*] Added automatic pause function when switching to another screen during battle
[*] Responds to resolution changes (official windowed mode is not supported yet)
[*] Added various tooltips
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.8 Update - New Tutorial!
notes.notes:
Commander, we're greeting you with the first update! We're back with a new tutorial!

We removed the existing poor tutorials and created a new tutorial to make it easier for commanders who are not familiar with the auto-batler and deck builder games.
Please check the updated contents along with the tutorial below.

In the future, we will periodically reflect the updates to the demo version and visit you through the update notes!

[list]

[*]Detailed tutorials have been added.
[*]Tutorials for new commanders will continue to be improved.
